title: Obuzdavanje, oporavak i runbookovi
summary: Obuzdavanje, iskorjenjivanje i oporavak za Linux hostove, kontejnere, Kubernetes i cloud naloge, runbookovi za procurjele ključeve, kriptominere i izložen storage i analiza nakon incidenta.
summary_en: Containment, eradication and recovery for Linux hosts, containers, Kubernetes and cloud accounts, runbooks for leaked keys, cryptominers and exposed storage, and the post-incident review.
